annotations.title: Is this injury or illness OSHA recordable?

description: Decide under 29 CFR 1904.4-1904.11, 1904.29 and 1904.39 whether a case goes on the OSHA 300 Log, its column (death, days away, restricted, other) and type, whether it is a privacy case, and whether OSHA must be called within 8 or 24 hours. First-aid ids: otcMedicationAtOtcStrength, tetanusImmunization, cleaningWounds, woundCoverings, hotColdTherapy, nonRigidSupport, temporaryImmobilizationForTransport, nailDrillingBlisterDraining, eyePatch, eyeForeignBodyIrrigationOrSwab, splinterRemovalSimple, fingerGuards, massage, drinkingFluidsHeatStress. Medical-treatment ids (any other text also counts as medical treatment): prescriptionMedication, sutures, rigidSplintOrCast, physicalTherapy, otherImmunization, eyeForeignBodyOtherMeans, woundClosingDevice, respiratoryTherapy, surgery. Work-relatedness exceptions: generalPublic, symptomsOnly, voluntaryWellness, eatingDrinking, personalTasks, personalGrooming, commuteParkingLot, coldOrFlu, mentalIllnessNoOpinion.

contaminatedSharps.description: Needlestick or cut from a sharp contaminated with another person's blood or OPIM

continuationOfRecordedCase.description: Same type of injury to the same body part, already recorded, not yet healed

daysAway.description: Calendar days away from work, not counting the day of injury

employeeRequestsPrivacy.description: Employee asked that their name be left off (illnesses only)

exception.description: A 1904.5(b)(2) exception that applies, if any

hoursAfterIncident.description: Hours from the incident to the death, hospitalization, amputation or eye loss

intimateBodyPart.description: Intimate body part or reproductive system

medicalRemoval.description: Medical removal under an OSHA standard

preExistingSignificantlyAggravated.description: For a pre-existing condition: did work significantly aggravate it?

restrictedDays.description: Calendar days of restricted work or job transfer

treatments.description: Treatments given: first-aid ids, medical-treatment ids, or plain text

tuberculosisAfterExposure.description: TB infection after occupational exposure to a known active case

type.description: injury, skin, respiratory, poisoning, hearing or other (illness)
